description: Experimental, opt-in (ENTIRE_GRAPH_PROMPT_CONTEXT=1): put the code graph's answer for the first prompt of a session into context, without a tool call.

hooks.command:
eg_prompt_opt_in="${ENTIRE_GRAPH_PROMPT_CONTEXT:-}"; eg_prompt_spaces=' 	
 '; eg_prompt_opt_in="${eg_prompt_opt_in#"${eg_prompt_opt_in%%[!$eg_prompt_spaces]*}"}"; eg_prompt_opt_in="${eg_prompt_opt_in%"${eg_prompt_opt_in##*[!$eg_prompt_spaces]}"}"; case "$eg_prompt_opt_in" in 1|[tT][rR][uU][eE]|[oO][nN]|[yY][eE][sS]) command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/entire-graph-prompt-context.py";; esac; exit 0
